FN-NUKDT8J-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 276
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Allen Treadaway
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/14/2024
House Bill 276 as introduced would allow certain law enforcement officers retired under the
Employees’ Retirement System (ERS) to return to work, without suspension of their retirement
allowance, as a police officer at a state college or university, provided that their compensation
does not exceed $52,000 per year. This bill would provide that this compensation cap for these
officers would be repealed on December 31, 2026.
This bill could increase the obligations of any state college or university that employs a retired
officer by an undetermined amount dependent upon any additional compensation paid to these
retirees under the provisions of this act. This bill could also increase the obligations of RSA by
an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of officers that retire and return to work as
a police officer at a state college or university and earn compensation above the current retiree
compensation cap but less than the proposed new maximum of $52,000 but who would not
otherwise have retired and received retirement benefits absent the provisions of this bill.

FN-NUKDT8J-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 276
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Allen Treadaway
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/03/2024
House Bill 276 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would allow
certain law enforcement officers retired under the Employees’ Retirement System (ERS) to
return to work, without suspension of their retirement allowance, as a law enforcement officer
for any state, county, municipal law enforcement agency, or any state college or university.
This bill could increase the obligations of any state, county, municipal law enforcement agency,
or any state college or university that employs a retired officer by an undetermined amount
dependent upon any additional compensation paid to these retirees under the provisions of this
bill.
This bill could also increase the unfunded liabilities of RSA by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the number of officers that retire, receive their retirement allowance, and return
to work as law enforcement officers at any state, county, municipal law enforcement agency or
state college or university earning compensation above the current retiree compensation cap but
who would not otherwise have retired and received retirement benefits, absent the provisions of
this bill.
